quiz.title: Data Warehousing and Data Architecture
quiz.description: Data warehouse concepts, OLAP vs OLTP, star and snowflake schemas, data lakes vs warehouses, and overall data architecture design.

questions.question_text: What is the main purpose of a data warehouse?
questions.option_a: To store integrated, structured data optimized for analytics and reporting
questions.option_b: To run the live production application
questions.correct_answer: To store integrated, structured data optimized for analytics and reporting

questions.question_text: How does OLTP differ from OLAP?
questions.option_a: OLTP handles many small transactional operations, while OLAP handles complex analytical queries over large datasets
questions.option_b: OLTP is only used for reporting
questions.option_c: OLAP is used to process payments
questions.option_d: There is no difference between them
questions.correct_answer: OLTP handles many small transactional operations, while OLAP handles complex analytical queries over large datasets

questions.question_text: In a star schema, what sits at the center, surrounded by dimension tables?
What is a 'dimension table' in a data warehouse?
questions.option_a: A table containing descriptive attributes, such as customer or product details
questions.option_b: A table containing only numeric measures
questions.option_d: A table used only for logging errors
questions.correct_answer: A table containing descriptive attributes, such as customer or product details

questions.question_text: What is the key difference between a data lake and a data warehouse?
questions.option_a: A data lake stores raw data in any format, while a warehouse stores structured, processed data for analysis
questions.option_b: A data lake only stores images
questions.option_c: A data warehouse cannot be queried with SQL
questions.option_d: They are exactly the same thing
questions.correct_answer: A data lake stores raw data in any format, while a warehouse stores structured, processed data for analysis

questions.question_text: What does the term 'data mart' typically refer to?
questions.option_a: A smaller, subject-specific subset of a data warehouse for a particular team or use case
questions.option_b: The physical building where servers are kept
questions.option_c: A backup of the entire company database
questions.option_d: A tool for writing Python code
questions.correct_answer: A smaller, subject-specific subset of a data warehouse for a particular team or use case

questions.question_text: What is a 'medallion architecture' (bronze/silver/gold) commonly used for?
questions.option_a: Organizing data lake data into progressively cleaned and refined layers
questions.correct_answer: Organizing data lake data into progressively cleaned and refined layers

questions.option_a: The traceable history of where data came from and how it was transformed
questions.option_b: The physical location of a data center
questions.option_d: The speed of a network connection
questions.correct_answer: The traceable history of where data came from and how it was transformed

questions.question_text: What is a key goal of good data architecture in an organization?
questions.option_a: Ensuring data is reliable, accessible, secure, and scalable across systems
questions.option_b: Making sure only one person can ever access the data
questions.option_c: Storing all data in a single spreadsheet
questions.option_d: Avoiding the use of any cloud services
questions.correct_answer: Ensuring data is reliable, accessible, secure, and scalable across systems

questions.option_a: A star schema where dimension tables are further normalized into related sub-tables
questions.option_b: A schema with no relationships between tables
questions.option_c: A schema used only for NoSQL databases
questions.correct_answer: A star schema where dimension tables are further normalized into related sub-tables

questions.question_text: Why is metadata management important in data architecture?
questions.option_a: It helps teams understand, discover, and trust the data they are using
questions.option_b: It is required to compile Python code
questions.option_c: It replaces the need for a database
questions.option_d: It only matters for image files
questions.correct_answer: It helps teams understand, discover, and trust the data they are using
